notes.title: IT'S XXXMAS UPDATE TIME!
notes.notes:
Ho-ho-ho there, friends!

It's great to see you guys again, getting ready for Christmas and New Year's Eve! Are you ready to unwrap your presents? Because we've prepared ours for you already. 

Please, welcome:
XXX-Mas stories!

Furry Shades Of Gay classic festive update is back - live, laugh, love with all of your favorite characters! And don't miss out on the sweetest discount - make your loved ones even happier with Furry Shades Of Gay 3 game in their library. Only raw emotions - just enough to fuel up your quality time with themːls_heartː

Have you ever wanted to decorate your Christmas tree like it's Halloween? Well, now you have a full scale permission from Percy and Blake to do so - they will lead you in such a hard task! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/d5912855e25fbfdbc00d02fc3bb705975d61a005.png

Or maybe it's time for some holiday gymnastics right before the fireplace? Mikey and Orlando are ready to show you some of their best moves. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/439dac28f8c9bdd7b956a2113290c456d0e32021.png

Only if you don't have plans with your daddy - mountains won't climb themselves, after all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/d549e3c6bd881762ebb2c2411cd886de4408c234.png

Unpacking gifts is always the most exciting part of the holdays - let Master demonstrate the art of wrapping and unwrapping one for himself.  Evan is happy to oblige, sweeties! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/3b3c2ca2bbf63119f964a05f1daa4973faa88208.png

Get cozy with your boyfriend in winter right beside the window and count the snowflakes together, or go for a walk under the Christmas lights! But we warn you: keep your private parts warm! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/66dea5e762fe932d0f4ee2d84f520aa04c4750ed.png

Happy upcoming holidays, let this Christmas be fun and not so family friendly when it comes to love!

Don't forget to share your thoughts and emotions with us on our social media - we love to see you excited about our boys so much!

notes.title: Valentine's update is here!
notes.notes:
Hey there, friends! 

Happy Valentine's Day to you all! Let the loved ones of yours know how much you love them tonight. And we've prepared decent discounts for you to help in this case! Grab Furry Shades Of Gay 3 with a nice discount of 30% now!

Now, let's celebrate together with a new story, shall we?

Evan and Master are back! 

This Valentine’s Day is special for Evan. Him and his Master have been together for quite a while, and he’s excited to spend this special day together. He's a little nervous though? What are they to each other? Friends with benefits or something more? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/86db977214ff80abd5d094b18018b51fd29c23df.png

You can tell he's not the only one having a crisis there - his Master is clearly trying to tell Evan something important. Will they get distracted during their happy little dinner with all the gear in Master's house, or will their choice be a little more romantic this time? 

Find out in the story! There are more secrets to this couple than you think. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/d7f2fdb6f4f4bf06016e693127a9802a88d3c704.png

There are some tech changes, too! The unlimited turns are coming to Furry Shades Of Gay 3 as a beta test, for you to try out and tell us what you think of this new feature. You can leave your comments on our Steam page, on Twitter and on Discord. Those who prefer to play the game old-fashioned style will be rewarded with new achievements a bit later, don't worry!
